# Fixed-price packages

> New offers use three packages: Starter, Standard and Premium. No more hourly billing.

- [decision] 2026-06-02: Decided in June after two spring projects ran over their estimates.
- [preference] 2026-06-02: The owner said: "Clients should know the price before we start."
